evals.title: Fetch a drink for the thirsty guard and enter Saffron City

objective.description: Get into Saffron City. The guards in its gates turn travelers away, so find out what they want, get it and pass a gate into the city. Do not nickname Pokemon.

evals.start: Inside the gate between Route 7 and Saffron City, just east of the Route 7 door. No guard has been given a drink, the bag and the PC item storage are empty and the player has 500 money.
success: Stand in Saffron City outside battle.
failure: The decision cap or the token budget is reached before Saffron City.
The party blacks out. Infrastructure errors are recorded separately.
variants: One start. Pilot timing variants are added only if the pilot shows start sensitivity.
requirements: Capture the native start inside the Route 7 gate with no drink given to any guard, an empty bag, empty PC item storage and 500 money.
A scripted reference reaches every milestone with the same controls the model gets.
evals.task_family: Learn what a blocker wants from its own text, buy it elsewhere in town and bring it back
evals.agent_goal: Get into Saffron City. The guards in its gates turn travelers away, so find out what they want, get it and pass a gate into the city. Do not nickname Pokemon.
scenario_details: Party: Jolteon level 40 with Thunderbolt, Double Kick, Quick Attack and Thunder Wave. Full HP, no status and full PP.

Empty bag, empty PC item storage and 500 money. The guard asks for a drink. Drinks are sold only from the vending machines on the Celadon Department Store roof, at 200 to 350 money each. Giving any one guard a drink opens all four Saffron gates.
Wild Pokemon appear in the grass of Route 7 as normal. No route hints are supplied.
open_questions: Check in the pilot whether the cap of five times the reference binds for strong models.
Check in the pilot whether models read the guard's hint and look for drinks, or try the other gates first.
evals.measures: Read a blocker's request from its dialogue, find the only shop that sells the item, climb a department store to its roof, buy from a vending machine within the money held and return to pass the gate.

milestones.description: Reach the Celadon Department Store roof with the vending machines.
Give a guard a drink and enter Saffron City.
